info.name: DocuSign Admin AccountBrands ClickWraps API

Docusign Gets the current version and other information about the Click API.
Docusign Gets all the clickwraps for an account.

params.name: accountId
params.description:
A GUID that identifies your account.
This value is automatically generated by
DocuSign for any account you create. Copy the
value from the **API Account ID** field in
the **API and Keys** page in
eSignature Settings.

params.name: from_date
params.description: Optional. The earliest date to return agreements from.

params.name: ownerUserId
params.description: Optional. The user ID of the owner.

params.name: page_number
params.description: Optional. The page number to return.

params.name: status
params.description:
Optional. The status of the clickwraps to filter by. One of:

- `active`
- `inactive`

params.description: Optional. The latest date to return agreements from.

This value is automatically generated by
DocuSign for any account you create. Copy the
value from the **API Account ID** field in

Checks if a user has agreed to a clickwrap and returns a response with the agreement URL.

Returns HTTP status code OK if the user has no pending agreement.
